traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are implemented and verified: - Before/after/mixed JSDoc tag coexistence is covered by dedicated valid tests using @story and @req around @param/@returns, all passing. - Proper termination and JSDoc tag boundary detection are implemented via isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine and the early-finalization branch in processCommentLine, preventing concatenation of subsequent JSDoc tags into story/req values. - Continuation logic and multi-line preservation are ensured by only extending pending annotation values on non-tag, non-empty lines, while terminating on any other @tag. - No false positives remain for valid annotations followed by JSDoc tags (the original bug scenario is now a passing valid test). - Existing behaviors (multiline support, error messaging for genuinely invalid annotations, CONFIG options) remain intact, as shown by comprehensive passing tests across all related stories. - Rule documentation has been updated with explicit JSDoc coexistence behavior and examples referencing this story. Therefore this story is fully satisfied in the current codebase.
